decision.explanation: All five positions are explicitly stated in the original sources. 'desservant' is mentioned in D1S2 and supported by multiple studies (D1S10–D1S16). 'member of the Council of State' appears in D1S8 and D2S10. 'Prefect of the Seine-et-Oise department' is stated in D2S10. 'deputy to the National Convention' is cited in D2S5. 'member of the Chamber of Peers' is directly stated in D2S2 and elaborated in D2S14–D2S16. These are distinct roles held by Sainte-Hermine at different times and are not mutually exclusive. The audit confirms direct support for each from the provided sources.
